environment.description: Application deployed behind an internal ALB in a private subnet. The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode, and (3) a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string parameters using pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|extractvalue|load_file)` with action BLOCK. The ALB listener has a fixed-response rule returning 403 for any request where the query string byte length exceeds 256 bytes. Additionally, the private subnet has no NAT gateway or internet gateway route, and the database file is mounted from an EFS volume with read-only mount option for the application container (writes go to a separate audit EFS mount point).

config.efs_mount: users.db on EFS with mount -o ro; audit_log on separate writable EFS
